note: No definition could be quoted. The stored files are the President's press releases on signing the Law 'On Artificial Intelligence' (official.html) and the related law amending legislative acts on artificial intelligence and digitalisation (secondary.html), both in Russian. Both say that the text of the law is being published in the press; neither contains it. The first release says that AI systems are defined as an object of informatisation and mentions AI models, but that is the release's summary, not the law's definition. not_found here means only that the law's definitions are not in the stored files.
